name: Qotusu
blurb: Continents of kingdoms and dwarf-holds, three underdark strata and sky isles. Two centuries of wars, plagues and fallen dynasties.

name: Mangrar
blurb: An archipelago of megacorps, arcologies and neon undercities. Gangers on the maglev, data vaults below.

name: Misuchu
blurb: One great continent of gene-clans and hive cities, mycelial warrens beneath, living airships above.
